toolsPreview.name: search
toolsPreview.description: Full-text search across Falcon's frontier design reference: terms, technologies, file formats, sensors, companies, tools, standards.

toolsPreview.name: get_definition
toolsPreview.description: Get the definition and reference copy for a dictionary term, technology, sensor, or file format by slug (use `search` to find slugs).

toolsPreview.name: get_company
toolsPreview.description: Profile of a frontier company: what they build, why it matters for frontier design, competitors and technologies from the knowledge graph.

toolsPreview.name: list_design_jobs
toolsPreview.description: Latest design/UX/HMI roles at frontier companies (defense, robotics, space, industrial, health), refreshed from company job boards.

toolsPreview.name: identify_format
toolsPreview.description: Identify a file format from an extension, filename, or slug (e.g. 'step', 'scan.mcap', 'gltf') and get how to open or convert it: what it stores, its extensions/MIME/spec, whether a free in-browser viewer exists, and available client-side conversions. Use for 'what is this file' / 'how do I open X'.

toolsPreview.name: compare_formats
toolsPreview.description: Compare two file formats (by slug, extension, or filename) — extensions, category, and a verdict on when to choose each. Use for 'X vs Y' / 'difference between X and Y'.

toolsPreview.name: convert_file
toolsPreview.description: Find the in-browser converter (if any) that turns one format into another, e.g. from='fbx' to='glb'. Returns the tool URL and notes, all client-side (files never upload). Use for 'how do I convert X to Y'.
